justifications.r1: Mardu mana rocks and 1-2 drop vampires.
justifications.r2: Vampire typal draw (Welcoming Vampire, Tocasia's Welcome, Skullclamp).
justifications.a1: High redundancy of 1-3 CMC aggressive vampires.
justifications.a2: Eminence generates tokens starting on Turn 1.
justifications.p1: Presents overwhelming vampire swarm on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps to swing for lethal.
justifications.p3: Wide creature swarm visible on table.
justifications.i2: Light incidental life drain; no hard denial.
justifications.s2: Eminence ensures every cast creature creates a free token even after wipes.
justifications.s3: Eminence operates completely from the command zone; Edgar rarely needs to be cast.
